items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 79:1
items.html: The ten Sefirot of the Sealed Brain are in the head of Arich Anpin, in which the palate is their Yesod and the throat is their Malchut. And although the illumination of the Sealed Brain cannot be revealed in the head, because of the dominance of the illumination of the Galgalta, which is greater than it, as is known, nevertheless the existence of the ten Sefirot of the Sealed Brain is there, only their illumination is not discernible there except in the body — that is, since the illumination of the Galgalta does not reach the body, the revelation of the Sealed Brain begins there. But the existence of the ten Sefirot of the Sealed Brain is certainly in the head. (Page 372, Item 165; and Page 376, Item 175).
